plugins.name: nodra-guide
plugins.description: Teaches Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode to use Nodra (CLI, sources, packaging, Works nodes, MCP servers, bots) from a bundled offline guide.

plugins.name: nodra-knowledge
plugins.description: Teaches Claude Code and Codex to use Nodra knowledge notes: read and write your local notes in ~/.nodra/knowledge.

plugins.name: nodra-package
plugins.description: Teaches Claude Code and Codex to turn a new or existing project into a valid Nodra package; then validate, pack and share it through a package source.

plugins.name: nodra-slides
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to build slide decks and documents as HTML that Nodra presents as a slideshow and exports to PowerPoint, Word and PDF, in a saved theme.
